address: 22 rue Sainte-Catherine Est, Montréal, H2X 1K4, Canada
bio: Right in the heart of the Quartier des Spectacles, a stone's throw from Place des Arts, Bouillon Bilk blends seamlessly into the bustling rue Sainte-Catherine. Behind the restaurant's plain façade, Chef François Nadon crafts cuisine imbued with influences from around the world, served in a refined setting. Celery root fried in panko is accompanied by a raw pear coulis and a miso sauce, with raw enoki and pan-fried shiitake. The just-seared scallops are set on a hazelnut butter and different textures of zucchini. For dessert, pastry chef Léa Godin Beauchemin creates a lovely combination of pear sorbet, pumpkin purée, oat crumble, and buttermilk granita. The wine list, selected by Minh Doan, is remarkable....
